method.landing: Actual normal first box release, plus isolated real fridge/ball and horizontal side-contact fixtures. The impact observer forwards the original callback without changing its arguments or result.
method.camera: Explicit presentation fixture: fixed view heights and beginIncident/endIncident calls. It does not claim to be a naturally triggered accident or gameplay survival test.
method.pause: Production lifecycle.togglePause freezes native simulation and presentation; browser timer only measures elapsed wall time.
method.limits: Rectangle coverage is not pixel seam inspection. Screenshots and video still need visual review. Browser validation is not WeChat real-device acceptance.
